005package org.wpilib.fields;
006
007import io.avaje.jsonb.Json;
008import java.util.Objects;
009
010/** Field image metadata. */
011@Json
012public final class FieldImage {
013  /**
014   * Field image path. JSON files store this relative to the JSON file's directory; built-in fields
015   * store the image resource path relative to {@link Fields#BASE_RESOURCE_DIR}.
016   */
017  @Json.Property("path")
018  public String path;
019
020  /** Top field boundary in image pixels. */
021  @Json.Property("top")
022  public int top;
023
024  /** Left field boundary in image pixels. */
025  @Json.Property("left")
026  public int left;
027
028  /** Bottom field boundary in image pixels. */
029  @Json.Property("bottom")
030  public int bottom;
031
032  /** Right field boundary in image pixels. */
033  @Json.Property("right")
034  public int right;
035
036  /** Constructs a field image metadata object. */
037  public FieldImage() {}
038
039  /**
040   * Constructs a field image metadata object.
041   *
042   * @param path Field image path. JSON files store this relative to the JSON file's directory;
043   *     built-in fields store the image resource path relative to {@link Fields#BASE_RESOURCE_DIR}.
044   * @param top Top field boundary in image pixels.
045   * @param left Left field boundary in image pixels.
046   * @param bottom Bottom field boundary in image pixels.
047   * @param right Right field boundary in image pixels.
048   */
049  public FieldImage(String path, int top, int left, int bottom, int right) {
050    this.path = path;
051    this.top = top;
052    this.left = left;
053    this.bottom = bottom;
054    this.right = right;
055  }
056
057  @Override
058  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
059    return obj instanceof FieldImage image
060        && Objects.equals(path, image.path)
061        && top == image.top
062        && left == image.left
063        && bottom == image.bottom
064        && right == image.right;
065  }
066
067  @Override
068  public int hashCode() {
069    return Objects.hash(path, top, left, bottom, right);
070  }
071}
